## Summary

- Adds draft v0.1 of the Agentic AI Security Best Practices Guide (Deliverable 4 of 5)
- Covers five domains: secrets management, secure tool invocation (MCP + supply chain), guardrails, eval frameworks, and post-incident forensics
- Each section follows a failure-pattern / control / decision-framework structure designed to give builders both the "why" and the "what"
- Closes with a curated tool reference table (maturity, cost, notes) and a full source ledger

## Out of scope (by design)

Identity and delegated authorization architecture (SPIFFE/SVID, RFC 8693, others) is explicitly excluded as this lives in the Identity and Trust WG.
